name: AI Content Automation for YouTube
description: A free and open-source tool that automates the creation of YouTube content by writing scripts, generating voiceovers, creating videos, and uploading them automatically, enabling hands-free YouTube growth powered by AI.

inputs.name: topic
inputs.description: The subject or theme for the YouTube video content.

inputs.name: script_parameters
inputs.description: Parameters or preferences to guide the script writing process (e.g., tone, style, length).

inputs.name: voiceover_settings
inputs.description: Settings for voiceover generation such as language, voice type, speed, and pitch.

inputs.name: video_assets
inputs.description: Visual assets like images or clips or instructions for automatic video generation.

inputs.name: upload_credentials
inputs.description: Authentication details for YouTube account to enable automatic video upload.

inputs.name: upload_metadata
inputs.description: Details for the uploaded video such as title, description, tags, and privacy status.

outputs.name: script
outputs.description: Generated script text for the video content.

outputs.name: voiceover_audio
outputs.description: AI-generated voiceover audio matching the script.

outputs.name: video_file
outputs.description: Created video combining voiceover and visual elements.

outputs.name: upload_status
outputs.description: Result status of the video upload process including success or error details.

patterns: AI-based text generation for script writing
Automated video assembly from audio and visual components
YouTube API integration for seamless video uploading
End-to-end content pipeline enabling hands-free operation
steps: Accept topic and optional parameters for script generation
Generate a video script using AI text generation models
Convert the script into voiceover audio using AI text-to-speech
Create video by synchronizing voiceover with visual assets or auto-generated footage
Authenticate and upload the finished video to YouTube using API
Return statuses and metadata of created content and upload
use_cases: YouTube content creators automating video production
Marketing teams generating video ads or promos rapidly
Educational content automation for video lessons
Small businesses producing frequent video updates without manual editing
Influencers streamlining content creation and publishing workflows

prompt_templates.name: script_generation_prompt
prompt_templates.template: Write a detailed script about the topic: {topic} with style {style} and length {length}.

prompt_templates.name: voiceover_generation_prompt
prompt_templates.template: Generate a natural voiceover for the script: {script} using voice type {voice_type} in language {language}.

prompt_templates.name: video_creation_prompt
prompt_templates.template: Create a video by combining the voiceover audio: {voiceover_audio} with visual assets according to theme {theme}.

prompt_templates.name: upload_video_prompt
prompt_templates.template: Upload the video file {video_file} to YouTube with title '{title}', description '{description}', and tags {tags}.
